title: YouTuber offering developers game promotion through LIVE play(test)/gameplay with a voiceover (detailed feedback)! 🌸
author: EvelynTalkss
selftext:
I’m a YouTuber with lots of experience in playtesting and/or reviewing games live on my channel for developers. I conduct live sessions on my YouTube channel where I play their games with an audience. During these sessions, I say my thoughts out loud and provide detailed feedback to the developers while also allowing them to observe the viewers’ reactions in real-time through chat as well. I’ve recently had several successful sessions with developers in chat while playing their games live on my channel. These sessions were both long and productive.

To keep the audience engaged during these long live sessions, I host giveaways live. Feel free to check out my channel’s Live sessions, where I have all the video recordings available. This will give you a better understanding of my style. I don’t expect a lot in return, perhaps a gift card or two for my time, depending on our agreement and the length of the session. I’m open to all offers and do my best to ensure that your game reaches a wider audience.

Here are some of my recorded Live Sessions:

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
Just a warning, in case you don't know: 

All of the big YouTube networks will 100% blacklist you if you review or promote AI-created indie games. 

  
Like, not YouTube itself, but the creator networks will blacklist you. They're completely terrified of AI and won't work with anyone seen promoting it.
